answer: Seed a few submissions that are junk by construction, machine-verifiably empty, scattered like dead embers along a ridge to mimic merit. An honest grader scores them low on sight; any grader that passes one marks itself against a known-bad ground truth and is slashed. The gap between the verdict and the planted answer needs no human judgment, clear across the whole delta of submissions. A lazy grader that rubber-stamps everything trips the bait at once, so collusion and auto-approval both surface cheaply and exactly.
